## Summary

Describe the user or maintainer problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm test:native`
- [ ] `pnpm check:docs`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm check:generated`
- [ ] Relevant Arduino target compiles
- [ ] Hardware evidence added where applicable

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] Configuration migration and backup compatibility considered
- [ ] Board pin/reservation impact documented
- [ ] Memory and generated-artifact budgets considered
- [ ] No credentials, private captures, or protocol documents included
- [ ] User documentation and changelog updated

## Hardware evidence

List the board, power method, PixLite model/firmware/API, GPIOs, network mode,
and remaining untested gates. Write `Not applicable` for documentation-only or
host-only changes.
